thread:
flo: ok this is important — tiny gnome found on snack shelf. who claims responsibility? :eyes:
ada: not me. he looked... like a very judgmental herb. :seedling: 
ben: I named him Sir Marmalade. he judges my yogurt choices. (reacts :laughing:)
lenny: Ops report: gnome is wearing a Post-it that says "on-call hero". is this a promotion or a threat?
flo: maybe both. proposing ritual: we induct him into the Gnome Guild. requirements: one pun, one snack offering, and at least one awkward photo.
marie: handing over cheddar square as tribute. will also sing 3 lines of the office pledge.
ada: can the pledge be just "may your cache be warm and your queues short"?
ben: yes. also we need a nameplate. I made a mockup: `> Sir Marmalade
> Keeper of Chips` (pastes ascii mockup)
ada: omg give him a Slack away message: `out gnome-ing, back at 3`
flo: @lenny can you add a tiny Do Not Disturb sign to his hat before tomorrow standup?
lenny: yes but only if he accepts automated pager duties. dev-bot, can you assign ephemeral pager to miniature statues? :robot_face:
dev-bot: automatic reply: I have no clearance for tiny statues. Please submit a PR to the MythicalArtifacts repo. :robot_face:
marie: PR title: `gnome: add on-call responsibilities to Sir Marmalade` (laughs)
ada: Poll time: should we start a gnome-photo album in #random-memories? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for shamefully normal behavior
ben: :thumbsup: (sets reaction)
flo: :thumbsup:
lenny: :thumbsup:
marie: :thumbsup:
ada: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Note: kitchen shelf inventory updated: +1 novelty figurine. (auto-logged)
ben: follow-up: if anyone leaves snacks that attract rival gnomes i'll call for a duel (gentle, with nerf swords).
flo: appointed @marie as Gnome Steward until attrition. please prepare adoption certificate "For exceptional judgment of snacks and morale"
marie: honored. will craft certificate and probably terrible clip art.
ada: can we have a tiny gnome Slack status emoji? petitioning design team.
lenny: if design approves, i'll engrave his nameplate with our tiny laser cutter tomorrow. bring safety goggles.
ben: long live Sir Marmalade. :seedling::crown:
flo: ok ritual at 3:15. bring snack offerings and puns. mandatory goofy hat optional. :party_popper:
marie: photo will be posted in the album. tagging everyone for attendance. @ada @ben @lenny @flo
ada: i'll be there with my pun: "Gnome-body expects the Spanish Inquisition, but everyone expects snacks."
ben: that's peak content. see you at 3:15.
(END)
